items.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
items.description: The cyber-attack, which the company describes as complex, is believed to be the largest ever of its kind.

items.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
items.description: It is Pike's first public statement since she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection in September.

items.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
items.description: Hundreds of people are also understood to have stayed in the front-line town, despite the dangers.

items.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.description: The American-made interceptors are the only effective weapon for downing Russia's ballistic missiles.

items.title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of top Poland court
items.description: The escalation came after the government suspended two senior justices and moved to bring criminal charges against them.

items.title: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
items.description: Novaya Gazeta has been one of the most high-profile independent news outlets in Russia over the last three decades.

items.title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
items.description: Óscar Puente has been facing calls to resign after two high-speed trains collided earlier in the week, killing at least 69 people.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
items.description: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.

items.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
items.description: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

items.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
items.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

items.title: Canada stops using 'avalanche dogs' for rescues in Rocky Mountains, stirring outrage
items.description: A 55-year-old dog rescue programme that has found missing hikers and children in the Canadian wilderness was axed as part of government budget cuts.

items.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
items.description: Erin Patterson argued her trial was unfair due to seven grounds but three appeal judges dismissed them all.

items.title: Democratic senator blames Egypt press crackdown on US military aid decision
items.description: Chris Murphy said waiving a human rights condition on aid paved the way for arrests of journalists.

items.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
items.description: End of subsidies and rising prices drive discontent, testing support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's government.

items.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
items.description: Dan S Sullivan, the incumbent Republican senator running for re-election, and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting Dan J Sullivan to also stand in the race.

items.title: Six dead after helicopter crashes in northern Indian state
items.description: The aircraft reportedly took off from the Hindu pilgrimage site of Badrinath on Friday afternoon before losing contact.

items.title: China denies allegations of spy operation targeting Nvidia CEO
items.description: US intelligence officials believe a Chinese businesswoman was gathering information for Beijing on the US chip-making giant, The New York Times reports.

items.title: Human rights lawyer couple sentenced to 10 years' prison in Pakistan
items.description: Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha were charged over an incident in 2024, when England's cricket team was touring Pakistan.

items.title: Swedish academic says he has been barred from UK over event with Palestine Action founder
items.description: Andreas Malm was due to appear on a panel alongside a co-founder of the proscribed group next week.

items.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales
items.description: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI own search summaries were affecting ad revenue.
